function.arguments: {"index": 3, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The raw comparison of response rates by sex is confounded by baseline severity, as the treatment was not randomised and clinicians assigned treatment preferentially to sicker patients. Cross-tabulation shows that females in the treatment arm have higher proportions of mild and moderate severity, while males have higher proportions of severe cases. Since severe patients have lower response rates, the raw difference (F - M = -2.87 percentage points) is misleading. To address this, I computed adjusted response rates using standardisation to the overall severity distribution. This adjustment accounts for the imbalance in severity between sexes and provides a fairer comparison of treatment response by sex."}
function.name: resolve_finding
